0022600085.text: The Orlando Magic host the Atlanta Hawks in the first game of both teams' 2026-27 seasons, and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) is out for Orlando, while Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain), and Noah Penda (hamstring) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. For Atlanta, Henri Veesaar (knee) is out and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Magic lost 0-4 to the Hawks in the 2025-26 season series, including a 130-101 loss in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Orlando a 55% chance to win.
